blog/age-calculator.title: How to Calculate Your Age Online | Mufeed Tools
blog/age-calculator.description: A simple way to find your age in years, months and days from your date of birth, on today's date or any date, with an example.
blog/age-calculator.h1: How to calculate your age online
blog/age-calculator.body:
Sometimes we need to know our exact age: for a government job application, a school admission or a form. Counting years, months and days by hand is not easy, especially when months have different lengths. Our age calculator does it in seconds.

Steps to find your age

  1. Choose your date of birth.
  2. The second box already holds today's date; leave it as it is.
  3. Press “Calculate age”.
  4. Your age appears in years, months and days.

Age on a particular date

A job notice often says your age must fall within a range by the closing date. In that case you need your age on that date, not today. Type that date into the second box.

An example

Suppose you were born on 15 March 2000 and want your age on 1 January 2027. The result is 26 years, 9 months and 17 days.

What else you get

  • Total days, weeks and hours
  • Your approximate age in Hijri (lunar) years
  • Days left until your next birthday and the weekday it falls on

One important note

The tool gives a straight Gregorian-calendar result. If an organisation has a special rule for counting age, check it in the notice.
blog/age-calculator.ctaText: Find your age now, completely free.

blog/whatsapp-direct.title: How to Message on WhatsApp Without Saving the Number | Mufeed Tools
blog/whatsapp-direct.description: How to start a WhatsApp chat without saving a number and how to create a wa.me link, with the country code written correctly.
blog/whatsapp-direct.h1: How to message on WhatsApp without saving the number
blog/whatsapp-direct.body:
Sometimes you need to message a shopkeeper, a delivery rider or a stranger just once and do not want their number in your contacts. The WhatsApp direct tool does it in seconds.

How to write the number

WhatsApp needs the number with its country code, and the leading zero must be dropped. Pakistan's code is 92.

  • Usual number: 0300 1234567
  • For WhatsApp: 92 300 1234567

In our tool, choose the country and type the number as it is; the tool removes the leading zero for you.

Steps

  1. Choose the country, for example Pakistan (+92).
  2. Type the mobile number.
  3. Write a ready message if you like.
  4. Press “Open chat in WhatsApp”.

Create a link and share it

The tool also builds a wa.me link, such as https://wa.me/923001234567. Copy it and put it on your shop page or bio so customers can start a chat with one tap.

Cautions

  • The chat will not open if the number is not on WhatsApp.
  • Do not put personal details in messages to people you do not know.
  • Our site is not affiliated with WhatsApp.
blog/whatsapp-direct.ctaText: Try it now, no need to save the number.

blog/horoscope.title: How to Find Your Zodiac Sign | Dates of the Twelve Signs | Mufeed Tools
blog/horoscope.description: A simple way to find your zodiac sign from your date of birth, with the dates of all twelve signs. Horoscopes are for fun only.
blog/horoscope.h1: How to find your zodiac sign
blog/horoscope.body:
Your sign depends on your date of birth. The year is divided into twelve parts, each with a sign. If you do not know yours, the horoscope tool works it out from your date of birth.

Steps to find your sign

  1. Type your name.
  2. Choose your date of birth.
  3. Press “Show my sign and fortune”.
  4. Your sign appears with a playful reading.

Dates of the signs

  • Aries: 21 March to 19 April
  • Taurus: 20 April to 20 May
  • Gemini: 21 May to 20 June
  • Cancer: 21 June to 22 July
  • Leo: 23 July to 22 August
  • Virgo: 23 August to 22 September
  • Libra: 23 September to 22 October
  • Scorpio: 23 October to 21 November
  • Sagittarius: 22 November to 21 December
  • Capricorn: 22 December to 19 January
  • Aquarius: 20 January to 18 February
  • Pisces: 19 February to 20 March

How is the reading made?

The tool picks from ready-written playful lines using a simple rule based on the length of your name and your date. There is no astronomical calculation.

An important note

Your sign is fixed by your date of birth, but the fortune is for fun only. No one can truly foretell the future, so please do not base a decision, business move or relationship on it.
blog/horoscope.ctaText: Find your sign now, completely free.
